scope: Exact Q4_K metadata reuse plus Qwen4Exp chunk256 at 512/1K

implementation.q4: Each fixed-worker exact Q4 gate/up CTA predecodes d*scale and dmin*min once per block/subblock into 2 KiB LDS; strict lane quant bytes, ordered FMAs, wave32 reduction, and serial wave accumulation are unchanged.
implementation.prefill: Public Qwen4Exp runner/generator default prefill chunk grows 64 to 256. Chunk128/256/512 were screened; 256 is the exact winner.
implementation.fallback: Qwen4ExpGGUFTextGenerator(prefill_chunk_size=64) retains the preceding schedule; direct selected Q4 remains the primitive fallback.
